verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches this story indirectly. Unstructured offers dedicated-instance/VPC deployment with 'full data isolation' for privacy and control, and claims GDPR-conformant data handling. Neither describes user-facing retention settings or data deletion controls. missing for 10: documented retention policies or configurable retention windows, explicit deletion of uploaded files and processed outputs, deletion APIs for job and customer data, and independent corroboration.
